answer: Carrier-verified eSIM identity makes each extra identity pay $15 a month; a farm running N fakes pays N×$15 a month and cannot share it because each number is tied to one carrier account and one SIM. A farm reusing one number for 500 seats dies by carrier-record check at 2: the duplicate flags both seats and the line is cut. The Nadir desk checks each number against the carrier ledger, the kernel registry holds one line per seat, and the Lotus auditor re-checks lines monthly, so a 500-seat farm pays $7,500 a month before one fake earns.
